# For AI agents

`inkmap` ships artifacts for coding agents alongside its code. This page lists
them, says where each lives in the repository, and points at the
machine-readable copies of this documentation.

## Skills

Skills are folders holding a `SKILL.md` (the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format): a description that tells an agent when to use it and a body with the procedure. Install one into your agent with `gh skill` (any host: `--agent claude-code`, `copilot`, `cursor`, `codex`, `gemini`), or use the copy bundled in the wheel.

### `inkmap-usage`

Use when you need per-pixel foreground/background separation of a printed mark in a photograph — a QR code, barcode, printed text, logo, or any shape you can model — or when you need to MEASURE something about the mark itself (its reflectance, density, colour, how much of it actually printed) rather than decode it. Triggers on “which pixels are the ink”, “segment the QR code”, “measure the printed area”, “ink coverage”, “foreground mask for this mark”, “is this print defective”, “compare two exposures of a label”, “subpixel mask”, “measure the barcode not read it”. Covers choosing a model, the corner-order trap, which of the three 0–1 channels to use for what, and the measurability gate that stops you reporting a number biased by tens of percent.

```bash
gh skill install thorwhalen/inkmap inkmap-usage --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`inkmap/data/skills/inkmap-usage`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/inkmap/tree/HEAD/inkmap/data/skills/inkmap-usage) (bundled with the pip package).

### `inkmap-dev-validation`

Read before changing anything in inkmap that could move a number — geometry, coverage rasterisation, refinement, blur estimation, measurement weighting, or a locator — and before regenerating docs/methods-and-results.md or docs/validation.md. Covers the three validation tiers (synthetic ground truth, real-photograph round-trip, corpus detection), how to run each, which numbers live in which document, and the half-pixel convention failures that any of these changes can silently reintroduce. Triggers on “regenerate the benchmarks”, “update the validation numbers”, “the report is stale”, “did that change accuracy”, or any edit to coverage.py / geometry.py / models/ / locate/.

```bash
gh skill install thorwhalen/inkmap inkmap-dev-validation --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`skills/inkmap-dev-validation`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/inkmap/tree/HEAD/skills/inkmap-dev-validation).

The bundled skills are also on disk after `pip install inkmap`, under the package’s `data/skills/` directory; link them into an agent without network access with `skill link-skills <that directory>`.

## Machine-readable documentation

This site publishes the same documentation in forms that fit an agent’s context window:

- [`llms.txt`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/inkmap/llms.txt): an index of every page with a one-line description ([llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) format)
- [`inkmap.md`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/inkmap/inkmap.md): the whole documentation as one Markdown file
- `<page>.html.md`: a rendered Markdown twin of every page, advertised from each page’s `<head>` with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`
- [`objects.inv`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/inkmap/objects.inv): the Sphinx inventory: a symbol-to-URL index (`sphobjinv convert plain objects.inv -`)
